verdict.rationale: Deel documents a public REST API at api.letsdeel.com, with example endpoints such as POST /rest/contracts. The docs cover API-token and OAuth2 authentication, header-based date versioning, an isolated sandbox with pre-populated data, and HMAC-signed webhooks. Probes confirm machine-readable docs via llms.txt and .md page variants, which suits AI-native use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and evidence of how much of the product the endpoints cover.
